content.title: Validate: usersRegenerate token override
content.description: Validate the library change: unit tests pass, backward compatibility maintained (existing callers unaffected), the new capability works as designed. Confirm the fix enables forwarding auth context for the target user.

content.content: Blocked by mqe2745ekb. The implementation task (token override for usersRegenerate) is still in 'todo' status and assigned to library-developer — the code change has not landed yet. I verified the current source: usersRegenerate(name: string) in packages/library/src/core/tracker.ts:1883 still takes only a single name parameter and calls resolveAuthor({ config, users, requiresWrite: true }) with no token-override option, and the self-service check at line 1904 is unchanged. There is nothing to validate yet. Reassigning to the manager so the implementation can be picked up; once mqe2745ekb is done I can re-validate.
